figurative_meaning_en: To beckon or call someone by snapping the fingers
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে চুটকি মেরে বিক্রেতাকে ডেকে আনলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: He called the servant by snapping his fingers.
In the market, I beckoned the vendor with a finger snap.
note: Refers to a common non-verbal gesture in Bengali social interactions
